scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Monochromatic finite sums and products in the positive integers” (preprints/Monochromatic-finite-sums-and-products-in-the-positive-integers-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 164 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ab835f6a98c10d6d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let r, m ≥ 1 be integers, and fix real numbers R ≥ 2 and D ≥ 1. For every coloring χ : N → [r], there are distinct positive integers a1 < · · · < am and a color c ∈ [r] such that χ ⎛ ⎝ ∑︂ j∈J aj ⎞ ⎠ = χ ⎛ ⎝ ∏︂ j∈J aj ⎞ ⎠ = c for every ∅ ̸= J ⊆ [m]. Equivalently, FS(A) ∪ FP(A) is monochromatic for a set A ⊂ N of cardinality m. The elements can additionally be chosen to satisfy a1 > R, ad > R ⎛ ⎝ ∑︂ k<d ak + ∏︂ k<d ak ⎞ ⎠ D (2 ≤ d ≤ m). (1.1)
